comparison.objective: Lift a toilet roll from a packed case by grasping through its core; the candidate configures gripper hardware.
comparison.physical_skill: Internal/core grasping and clutter clearance of a deformable paper roll, not threaded tool manipulation.
comparison.success_condition: Roll must clear the case without damage or unacceptable disturbance and reach the released target state.
comparison.reason: Both available versions test extraction from packing, not stop-screw locking.
